name: Heatstroke Stila
bio: Stila wanted to join the Winterguard, but was turned away – they didn’t think they needed a Magmablood. Stila’s answer? A demonstration of her bow, capable of launching molten steel hot enough to melt through even the coldest Icebound. The Winterguard changed their tune nice and quick after that.
